Where should it go?

You see the whole book first. Once you approve it, we print and post it, usually within 7–12 working days. UK postage is £3.99.

We send your receipt and the finished proof here. We keep their book for 7 days, and may remind you once or twice if you don’t finish. Unsubscribe any time.
